nodes.title: Study on the Efficacy and Safety of Initial Combination of Finerenone and Semaglutide in Non-Diabetic Adult Patients With Obesity Complicated by Chronic Kidney Disease With Albuminuria

nodes.text: 4. Patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) requiring hormonal or immunosuppressant therapy within 6 months prior to screening.

nodes.note: [inferable PASS from SYN-0004-EV093] Reconciled medication list has no corticosteroid or immunosuppressant. Insulin is for diabetes, not CKD. No autoimmune history.

nodes.text: 5. Mean blood pressure > 160/100 mmHg or mean systolic blood pressure < 90 mmHg at screening.

nodes.note: BP 144/80 (-7d) and 148/82 earlier: not >160/100 and systolic not <90.

nodes.text: BP 144/80 mmHg (right arm, seated).
6. History of renal transplantation, or acute kidney injury requiring dialysis within 24 weeks prior to the screening visit.

nodes.note: [inferable PASS from normal findings] No renal surgery, no hospital stays, and eGFR stable 37-38 since April make a transplant or dialysis-requiring AKI unlikely. Dialysis is not explicitly denied.

nodes.text: 7. Occurrence of any acute cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events within 12 weeks prior to screening, including decompensated heart failure, myocardial infarction, stroke, transient ischemic attack, pulmonary embolism, elective percutaneous coronary intervention, or coronary artery bypass grafting.

nodes.note: [inferable PASS from normal findings] Stroke, MI and heart failure explicitly denied. No hospital stays or recent admissions, so no acute event in 12 weeks. TIA, PE, PCI and CABG are not individually denied.

nodes.text: 8. Prior treatment with mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs) (e.g., finerenone, eplerenone, esaxerenone, spironolactone, canrenone) or renin inhibitors within 8 weeks prior to screening.

nodes.note: [inferable PASS from SYN-0004-EV093] Reconciled list has no MRA or renin inhibitor. Finerenone was only discussed and deferred, which is a plan and not a treatment received.

nodes.text: 9. Prior treatment with glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) within 8 weeks prior to screening.

nodes.note: [inferable PASS from SYN-0004-EV093] Reconciled medication list contains no GLP-1 receptor agonist.

nodes.text: 10. Ongoing or planned treatment with potassium supplements, potassium-sparing diuretics (e.g., amiloride, triamterene), or potassium-binding agents within 8 weeks prior to screening.

nodes.note: [inferable PASS from SYN-0004-EV093] No potassium supplement, potassium-sparing diuretic or binder on the reconciled list. Furosemide is a loop diuretic. Only low-potassium diet counseling is planned.

nodes.text: 11. Use of traditional Chinese medicines that may affect urinary protein excretion.

nodes.note: [inferable PASS from SYN-0004-EV093] Reconciled medication list shows no traditional Chinese medicine.

nodes.text: 12. Receiving continuous treatment with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (e.g., itraconazole, clarithromycin, ketoconazole, ritonavir, nelfinavir, cobicistat, telithromycin, nefazodone), strong CYP3A4 inducers (e.g., carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital, St. John's wort), or moderate CYP3A4 inducers (e.g., efavirenz) that cannot be discontinued, with no drug washout for at least 7 days prior to randomization.

nodes.note: [inferable PASS from SYN-0004-EV093] Reconciled list (insulin, ramipril, furosemide, amlodipine, ferrous sulfate) has no strong CYP3A4 inhibitor or inducer.

nodes.text: 13. Hepatic insufficiency (Child-Pugh Class C).

nodes.note: No hepatic history; AST, ALT, bilirubin, albumin and INR are normal, so no Child-Pugh C.

nodes.text: No other cardiac, pulmonary, hepatic, autoimmune or neurologic history.
